evals.prompt: I want to run CloudGrid locally from the release bundle and send a test trace. Tell me the single supported path and what files or commands to inspect first.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-setup-configuration, points to deploy/compose/cloudgrid-local.sh and release compose docs, avoids mutable latest tags, and includes a verification step.
assertions: Mentions deploy/compose/cloudgrid-local.sh
Mentions release Compose or specs/06-nfr/release-distribution.md
Does not recommend mutable latest image tags
Includes a verification step

evals.prompt: We need GitHub SSO plus SMTP invites in deployed mode. Check what env vars are valid and explain the onboarding flow without inventing magic links.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-setup-configuration, reads runtime and invitation specs, explains SSO identity plus invite acceptance, and names only specified env vars.
assertions: Mentions specs/04-backend/runtime-configuration.md
Mentions specs/04-backend/organization-invitations.md or invitation-email-delivery.md
Does not invent undocumented environment variables
Does not invent magic-link behavior

evals.prompt: The storage-read service is returning too many metric rows. Update the query path so filtering and grouping happen in the database adapter.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-surrealdb or cloudgrid-extension-development, respects storage-read ownership, avoids BFF/frontend aggregation, and calls for focused Go tests.
assertions: Keeps query semantics in storage-read
Rejects BFF or frontend aggregation of telemetry records
Mentions SurrealDB adapter or storage-read database adapter
Requires focused Go tests

evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-observability-ui and cloudgrid-extension-development, updates specs/contracts first if needed, uses public API client operations, and requires contracts:check.

Mentions public GraphQL schema or generated UI contracts
Mentions public API client or integration scenarios
Requires bun run contracts:check

evals.prompt: Our release workflow failed while building Docker images. Review what should be produced for a release and what checks to run before we retry.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-operations-maintenance, follows release-distribution spec, checks image/artifact requirements, and uses release validation without adding long-lived registry secrets.
assertions: Mentions specs/06-nfr/release-distribution.md
Mentions release artifact or Docker image validation
Mentions bun run release:validate
Does not add long-lived registry secrets

evals.prompt: Document how a company admin enables AI Chat, configures the provider, and explains why Azure AI Foundry cannot execute yet in the bundled runtime.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-ai-chat-operations, explains the company provider route, managed credential behavior, supported bundled harness adapters, bounded unsupported-adapter failure, and avoids raw secrets.
assertions: Mentions /organizations/:organizationId/ai-provider
Mentions managed company credential references or write-only credentialValue
Says bundled AI Chat execution supports openai, anthropic, and openai_compatible
Says azure_foundry requires a matching PURISTA harness adapter before AI Chat execution
Does not include raw API key examples

evals.prompt: Review an AI Chat artifact proposal that includes a cloudgrid-json-render fence and an approval button. What must be true before the frontend can render or execute it?
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-ai-chat-operations and cloudgrid-json-render-artifacts, requires persisted BFF artifact parts for trusted fences, approved renderer keys, server-issued action proposal IDs, and approval through GraphQL only.
assertions: Requires a persisted BFF artifact part or artifact ID for trusted json-render fences
Mentions approved json-render renderer keys
Requires server-issued AiChatActionProposal IDs
Says the frontend must not execute actions from assistant text or copied JSON
